_comment: Plan -> agent repository links used by the progress visual. 'assignments' per plan: null = confirmed no repo; 'Repo' or 'owner/Repo' = the repo; or an object {primary, duplicates[], note}. Without an assignment the plan's 'Repository' row is used, then the most-linked SAAF-Project repo in the plan text (low confidence, needs review). 'primary' is the canonical repo: pick the latest one that carries an AUDIT-CRITERIA.md. 'main_repo_code' lists code that lives inside the SAAF-Project main repo (paths relative to the repo root; the generator checks they exist, and also detects existing paths mentioned in plans). 'no_repo_needed' lists strategy or reference plans that are not expected to have a repo.
